inbox.title: Approval inbox
inbox.description: Requests waiting for your decision, earliest due first. Only requests within your approval authority, or authority delegated to you, are listed.
inbox.emptyDescription: There is nothing waiting for your decision.
inbox.caption: Requests waiting for your decision

done.approve: Approved. The request moves to its next stage, or is complete if this was the last one.
done.reject: Rejected. The requester can see your reason.
done.return: Returned to the requester with your reason. A corrected version comes back as a new request.
done.escalate: Escalated. The task has passed to the escalation role.

decision.reasonRequiredHint: Required. The requester reads this reason.
decision.reasonOptionalHint: Optional. The requester can read it.

approve.title: Approve request
approve.body: Approve this request at your stage.

reject.title: Reject request
reject.body: Rejecting ends the request: it is refused and goes no further.

return.title: Return request
return.body: Returning ends this request and sends it back to its author, who can correct and resubmit it as a new revision.

escalate.title: Escalate overdue task
escalate.body: The task is past its due date. Escalating passes it to the escalation role, which then decides in its place.

requests.title: My requests
requests.description: Requests you submitted for approval, newest first.
requests.empty: You have not submitted any requests for approval.
requests.emptyFiltered: None of your requests has this status.
requests.caption: Requests you submitted

withdraw.title: Withdraw request
withdraw.body: Withdrawing ends the request without a decision and cancels the tasks still open. This cannot be undone.

history.title: Approval history
history.outcomeDelivered: Outcome sent to the source record

delegations.title: Delegated approvals
delegations.description: A delegate can decide what you could decide yourself, judged at the moment they act, and nothing more.
delegations.givenEmpty: You have not delegated your approval authority.
delegations.receivedEmpty: No one has delegated approval authority to you.

delegate.title: Delegate approval authority
delegate.note: Your delegate decides with your authority as it stands when they act. If you lose authority, so do they.
delegate.delegateHint: An active internal user. External users cannot hold approval authority.
delegate.routingKeyHint: Leave empty to delegate every kind of request.

revoke.title: Revoke delegation
revoke.body: {name} will no longer be able to decide on your behalf. Decisions already made stand.

problems.terminalState: This has already been decided or ended, so nothing was changed. The list has been refreshed.
problems.stageNotReached: This task's stage has not been reached yet.
problems.permissionDenied: You do not have approval authority for this.
problems.configurationMissing: The approval route or workflow policy for this request is not configured. Contact the PMO.
problems.concurrentDecision: Someone else decided on this request just before you, so your decision was not saved. The list has been refreshed.
problems.reasonRequired: Enter a reason for rejecting or returning the request.
problems.escalationNotAllowed: This task cannot be escalated: it is not overdue, not in the current stage, or already an escalation.
problems.delegateInvalid: Choose an active internal user other than yourself.
problems.delegationPeriodInvalid: The period must not start in the past, and must end after it starts.
